en.name: Scab Scarknight
en.effect: You can only control 1 "Scab Scarknight". Cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card is in face-up Defense Position, destroy this card. Monsters your opponent controls must attack this card, if able. At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card battled: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls that battled this card this Battle Phase; take control of it.
